summary: Agenus Inc. filed an 8-K (Item 1.01) reporting an amendment to existing notes and warrants with existing noteholders. The amendment extends the maturity of $5.09 million in 2015 senior subordinated promissory notes by eight months to February 18, 2027, extends expiration dates of A, B, and C warrants to June 25, 2031, and issues new D warrants for 56,525 shares at a $3.25 exercise price. This is a routine debt restructuring and warrant extension, not a special situation. No board recommendation or advisors named. No risk-arb angle; watch for dilution from warrant exercises.
